description: Use this when the connected user asks about current AIApply job preferences or before suggesting a change. Read target roles, locations, work types, experience, salary, exclusions, daily limit, and application mode without modifying them. Nothing here can change them: to change one, call open_auto_apply_preferences for the page the user changes it on. Needs an AIApply account: if the user has not signed in, calling it asks them to sign in or create one.
name: get_auto_apply_preferences
title: Get AIApply job preferences
